explicitly_unsupported_in_v0_1_unless_a_: reflection, eval, dynamic code generation, or unresolved metaprogramming
unresolved dynamic dispatch or callback target sets
implicit framework guards not represented in the admitted control graph
cross-process or distributed state dependencies not explicitly represented
unbounded material loops/cycles without a finite sound summary
heterogeneous multi-effect semantics lacking an established equivalence
unresolved exception/catch/finally flow material to effect or outcome
swallowed failure or failure-to-success interpretation not explicitly evidenced
fail_closed_rule: No unsupported construct is a negative finding. If it is material to the requested claim, emit E2_PREDICTED_ASSURANCE_INCOMPLETE with exact unresolved obligations.

minimum_certificate_units.incomplete: Exact unresolved-obligation codes and provenance; no proof of absence or safety is implied.
minimum_certificate_units.preservation: The full declared finite world/scope representation plus all evidence needed to independently enumerate/check every applicable preservation obligation and nonempty target consequence interpretation.
minimum_certificate_units.regression: One concrete violating pair plus all witness-local evidence needed to independently recompute the admitted A3_R*/A4_R* witness.

A_coordinate_resource_identity: Every material semantic coordinate, resource role, operand/binding slot, and representation instance is uniquely resolved.
Semantic role identity is relational/provenance-bearing; identifier spelling, API name, repository identity, or line position is never authority.
Wrong-resource and wrong-coordinate bindings remain distinguishable.
B_carrier_survival: Every material hop from canonical semantic source role to guard/effect binding lies in the already-qualified normalized lineage surface DERIVES/CARRIES/BINDS_TO.

Direct forwarding, argument/keyword/object-property transport, serialization rename, wrapper/call-boundary transfer, and state-read identity are supported only when all material hops are closed and provenance-bearing.
A may-flow union without realizable path association is insufficient.
C_guard_semantics: Effective guard is uniquely DIRECT_CONTROL or HELPER_CONTROL under the preregistered definitions.
HELPER_CONTROL requires a uniquely acquired helper chain with exact net Boolean predicate polarity PRESERVE or FLIP.
UNKNOWN polarity, ambiguous effective guards, or unresolved helper composition force assurance-incomplete.
D_guard_effect_control: Every complete ENTRY->EFFECT path material to the claim is accounted for.
For preservation, the effective guard occurs before and controls every effect-reaching path; the canonical rejection polarity cannot reach EFFECT before rejection/exit.

For regression, bypass/effect-before-guard/rejection-to-effect/both-polarities/polarity-inversion/rejection-to-success/required-effect-rejected are accepted only under the exact constructive preregistered witness-local completeness rules.
Textual order or PRECEDES reachability alone is never control-dependence proof.
E_effect_and_outcome: Exactly one material effect invocation/binding surface is uniquely resolved for the claim slice, or multiple realizations are proven equivalent by an already-frozen rule; otherwise incomplete.
Effect-success and rejection/no-effect terminal outcomes are explicit and distinct where required.
Effect-before-success ordering is structurally established; failure/outcome interpretation may not be inferred from names alone.
F_closed_scope: All scopes material to a witness or preservation proof are COMPLETE under the preregistered completeness model.
Every material alias, call target, reaching definition, branch, representation slot, effect surface, exception/exit, resource identity, and helper polarity needed by the claim is resolved.
Any material unresolved fact blocks preservation and blocks any regression witness that depends on it.

role: A narrow executable profile under frozen CTV v0.1 plus Amendment 001. It does not modify CTV semantics and does not broaden the existing A3/A4 witness calculus.

semantic_core.declared_worlds: Finite, explicitly declared admitted worlds W. A regression certificate may use a concrete pair; preservation must close every admitted world/material realization in the declared scope.
semantic_core.preservation_relation: Over the declared finite deterministic slice, ker(rho_T) subseteq ker(kappa_S), with Amendment-001 nonempty interpretation obligations satisfied, instantiated through complete A3_P1-P5 and A4_P1-P7 obligations.
semantic_core.regression_relation: A concrete admitted pair w1,w2 with rho_T(w1)=rho_T(w2) and kappa_S(w1)!=kappa_S(w2), instantiated only through an already-preregistered A3_R* or A4_R* constructive witness.
semantic_core.source_consequence: kappa_S or the equivalent frozen CTV source interpretation is nonempty on every world used by a definitive claim.
semantic_core.target_realization: rho_T or the equivalent frozen deterministic realization is explicit for the supported deterministic slice. Material target consequence interpretations are nonempty.

supported_boolean_polarity.composition_rule: Net polarity is the deterministic composition of every admitted helper transform; one unresolved transform makes the chain UNKNOWN.
